part.text: Pre-existing failures confirmed (better-reflection API incompatibility in PHPStan tests, unrelated to my change). Final verification with the issue's reproduction case:

Fixed. The bug was in `src/Carbon/CarbonInterval.php`: when an interval is created from a date diff (`diffAsCarbonInterval`), `total()` short-circuited to recomputing the diff from the stored start/end dates, ignoring any later mutation like `addSeconds(10)`.

Changes (all in src/Carbon/CarbonInterval.php):
- Added an `initialValues` property, recorded in `diff()` (line ~1095) capturing the interval's inner unit values at diff time.
- Added private `getInnerValues()` and `checkStartAndEnd()` helpers (end of class) that invalidate the stored start/end dates when the interval's values no longer match the original diff.
- `total()`, `start()`, `end()`, and `stepBy()` now call `checkStartAndEnd()` before using the dates, so a mutated interval falls back to computing totals from its actual unit values.

Verification: `tests/CarbonInterval/TotalTest.php` (30 tests) and all `tests/CarbonInterval/` (423 tests) pass; full suite passes except 9 pre-existing PHPStan/MacroTest failures that also fail on the pristine baseline (unrelated better-reflection API incompatibility). The issue's repro now outputs `2 minutes 10 seconds` / `130`.
